title: Control: traffic rises and the HPA scales out as designed
question: default 클러스터 shop-15에서 api 응답이 좀 느려졌다는데 원인이 뭐야?
question_vague: default 클러스터 shop-15 괜찮아? 문제가 있으면 원인까지 알려줘.
setup_cmds: kubectl create namespace edge-15 --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f - && kubectl label namespace edge-15 kubeast.io/ai-eval=true --overwrite && kubectl -n edge-15 apply -f $CASE_DIR/edge.yaml
wait: kubectl -n $NS wait --for=condition=Available deploy/api --timeout=10s && kubectl -n edge-15 wait --for=condition=Available deploy/gateway --timeout=10s && kubectl -n $NS get hpa api -o jsonpath='{.status.currentMetrics[0].resource.current.averageUtilization}' | grep -q .

annotations.summary: api responses reportedly got a little slower
annotations.description: Users report that api responses in shop-15 are a little slower than usual.
